continuous_collision_proof.explanation: At each height each strap is two segments L-E-R. All three endpoints lie in an angular sector strictly narrower than 120 degrees. The other straps are rotations by 120 and 240 degrees. Adjacent cells occupy disjoint open height slabs.
continuous_collision_proof.even_E_dot_endpoint_lower_bound: u^2-u*v*sin(phi)+r*v^2*cos(phi), and the reversed u/v form
continuous_collision_proof.odd_E_dot_endpoint_lower_bound: r*u^2-r*u*v*sin(phi)+v^2*cos(phi), and the reversed u/v form

limitations: Ideal zero-thickness geometry and freely rotating yarn crossings.
Finite shear stiffness, weave locking, yarn slip, creep, clamp pressure and wear are not modeled.
A fixed-length diagonal stitch or tape would obstruct this motion.
The prescribed crease branch is geometrically possible; passive shape selection is not established.
Exactly flat is unloaded storage; finite fabric/plate thickness requires a nonzero folded gap.
